name: Kathleen Norman

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large primary residence with multiple sections|A long, paved driveway provides access from the street toward the house|An unpaved road wraps around the residence, creating a loop|A swimming pool is visible near the main structure|The lot features extensive mature trees, landscaping, and open areas surrounding the residence|The property sits on a larger lot with significant open land and native vegetation around it.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a large home with multiple roof sections and a covered entry area|A long paved driveway leads toward the front of the house|Mature trees and landscaping are present along both sides of the driveway and near the front of the structure|The home has open space around.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence is bordered by dense mature trees and landscaping|The swimming pool area is visible|A small portion of this side of the residence is blocked by large trees|Open land is visible beyond the tree line|The unpaved loop around the residence is visible.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence includes the swimming pool and surrounding hardscape and lawn areas|Mature trees and vegetation border the rear of the property|Open space is visible around the pool and house.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side elevation with mature trees and landscaping running along the edge|The swimming pool area is partially visible in the background|Scattered vegetation occupies this side of the property|Staging material is seen in a gully on this side of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a long, paved driveway that curves from the street toward the front and side of the house and provides space for vehicle turnaround. The swimming pool and surrounding hardscape offer open areas for movement at the rear. Mature trees and landscaping are present along multiple sides of the building and may limit visibility and movement in those areas. The property has good overall access from the main driveway, the unpaved loop around the residence and tree coverage denser around the residence could affect response times and sightlines in certain conditions. The larger lot and surrounding open land provide more space for staging.
clarifications: Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the property? Is vehicle access available to the rear of the house near the pool? Are there any additional access points or pathways not visible from the available imagery? How much open land surrounds the property, and does it affect access or staging options?
